title: Pirates
premise: A young man from 2022 is transported into the dangerous Caribbean during the Golden Age of Piracy, where he must earn the trust of a pirate crew, survive deadly rivalries, uncover the secrets of a temporal artifact, and discover whether he can ever return home.
logline: A modern-day young man stranded in the pirate age must become one of history's most feared sailors to unlock a mysterious artifact capable of bending time itself.

visualTone.cameraLenses: Cooke Panchro Classic 32mm, 50mm and 75mm / Panavision C-Series Anamorphic 40mm
visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Naturalistic maritime realism with golden-hour backlight, candlelit interiors, moonlit silhouettes, volumetric storm atmospherics and dramatic chiaroscuro contrast

sets.name: Black Tide Pirate Ship
sets.description: A weathered brigantine with scarred teak decks, towering masts, rope rigging, patched sails, rusted cannon mounts and years of battle damage.
sets.atmosphere: Salt mist, sea spray, humid air and endless ocean horizons.
sets.lighting: Golden sunlight through sails during day, lantern illumination at night.

sets.name: Port Nassau Tavern
sets.description: A crowded timber tavern packed with smugglers, sailors, gamblers and mercenaries.
sets.atmosphere: Rum fumes, cigar smoke, spilled ale and constant tension.
sets.lighting: Flickering candles and warm amber lantern light.

sets.name: Hidden Jungle Cove
sets.description: A tropical cove secluded by cliffs, tangled vegetation and crystal waters.
sets.atmosphere: Heavy humidity, birds, insects and rolling sea fog.
sets.lighting: Filtered emerald sunlight through dense canopy.

sets.name: Storm-Battered Reef
sets.description: A deadly reef covered with coral spikes, wreckage and crashing surf.
sets.atmosphere: Thunderstorms, violent winds and relentless waves.
sets.lighting: Blue-grey storm ambience illuminated by lightning strikes.

sets.name: Ancient Spanish Ruins
sets.description: Collapsed stone ruins consumed by jungle vines and forgotten by history.
sets.lighting: Sunbeams piercing through broken arches and stone chambers.

characters.name: Ethan Ward
characters.description: 23 years old, athletic build, brown eyes, short dark hair, clean-shaven face and modern appearance.
characters.behavioralTraits: Adaptive, intelligent, curious, cautious and courageous when necessary.

characters.name: Captain Blackthorne
characters.description: Late forties, weathered skin, blue eyes, grey beard and a prominent facial scar.

characters.name: Isabella Cortez
characters.description: Early thirties, sharp features, olive complexion and dark braided hair.

characters.name: Gideon Flint
characters.description: Broad-shouldered giant with scars, shaved head and a broken nose.

costumes.name: Modern Survivor Clothing
costumes.description: Hoodie, jeans, sneakers and makeshift repairs.

costumes.name: Captain's Regalia
costumes.description: Tricorn hat, long naval coat, leather belts and ceremonial sash.

costumes.name: Treasure Hunter Attire
costumes.description: Explorer's coat, fitted trousers, utility belts and durable boots.

costumes.name: Enforcer Battle Gear
costumes.description: Sleeveless coat, reinforced boots and combat harness.

costumes.name: Trusted Deckhand Garb
costumes.description: Loose pirate shirt, patched trousers and working belts.

props.name: Temporal Compass
props.description: A brass compass engraved with impossible symbols and mysterious mechanisms.
props.narrativeSignificance: The only clue to Ethan's return home.

props.name: Captain's Flintlock
props.description: Decorative naval pistol with engraved metalwork.

props.name: Treasure Map
props.description: Ancient parchment covered in coded directions.
props.narrativeSignificance: Guides the heroes toward the artifact.

props.name: Cutlass
props.description: Curved pirate sword bearing signs of countless battles.
props.narrativeSignificance: Symbolizes survival in the pirate world.
props.handlingNote: Carried on a belt and drawn swiftly.

props.name: Iron Key
props.description: Ancient Spanish key marked with cryptic symbols.

props.name: Captain's Logbook
props.description: Leather-bound journal filled with routes and forgotten legends.
props.narrativeSignificance: Contains clues about the temporal mystery.
props.handlingNote: Stored carefully and protected from seawater.

roles.description: Ethan Ward wearing Modern Survivor Clothing becomes The Castaway, a confused outsider trying to survive in the pirate age.
Captain Blackthorne wearing Captain's Regalia becomes The Pirate Captain, the feared leader of the Black Tide crew.
Isabella Cortez wearing Treasure Hunter Attire becomes The Treasure Seeker, an explorer obsessed with uncovering forgotten secrets.
Gideon Flint wearing Enforcer Battle Gear becomes The Enforcer, a brutal fighter who enforces the captain's will.

shots.description: The Castaway clutches the Temporal Compass whilst standing on the Storm-Battered Reef.

action.roleActions: Staggers through crashing waves and struggles to maintain footing after arriving in an unfamiliar century.
action.soundDesign: Thunderclaps, crashing surf, distant wind howl.

shots.description: The Pirate Captain raises the Captain's Flintlock whilst standing on the Black Tide Pirate Ship.

action.roleActions: Steps onto the quarterdeck and surveys the crew.
action.dialogue: The sea belongs to those bold enough to take it.
action.soundDesign: Creaking timbers, snapping sails, ocean wind.

shots.description: The Enforcer grips the Cutlass whilst standing on the Black Tide Pirate Ship.

action.roleActions: Circles the newcomer and sizes him up as a threat.

shots.description: The Castaway inspects the Temporal Compass whilst standing on the Black Tide Pirate Ship.

action.roleActions: Rotates the compass and studies the impossible markings.
action.soundDesign: Faint metallic ticking and ocean ambience.

shots.description: The Castaway hides the Temporal Compass whilst standing inside the Port Nassau Tavern.

action.roleActions: Keeps his hood lowered and avoids eye contact.
action.soundDesign: Tavern chatter, mugs hitting tables, distant laughter.

shots.description: The Treasure Seeker studies the Treasure Map whilst standing inside the Port Nassau Tavern.

action.roleActions: Spreads the map across a table and points to hidden routes.
action.dialogue: This map leads somewhere legends fear to name.
action.soundDesign: Candle crackle and subdued crowd noise.

shots.description: The Pirate Captain opens the Captain's Logbook whilst standing on the Black Tide Pirate Ship.

action.roleActions: Turns weathered pages searching for a forgotten entry.

shots.description: The Trusted Deckhand carries the Cutlass whilst standing on the Black Tide Pirate Ship.

action.roleActions: Works alongside sailors hauling ropes and securing cargo.

shots.description: The Treasure Seeker unfolds the Treasure Map whilst standing inside the Hidden Jungle Cove.

action.roleActions: Compares landmarks against the map markings.
action.dialogue: We're exactly where the trail begins.

shots.description: The Pirate Captain points the Captain's Flintlock whilst standing inside the Hidden Jungle Cove.

action.roleActions: Addresses the assembled crew before the expedition.

shots.description: The Enforcer swings the Cutlass whilst standing inside the Hidden Jungle Cove.

action.roleActions: Charges toward rival treasure hunters and clears a path.

shots.description: The Castaway grips the Temporal Compass whilst standing inside the Hidden Jungle Cove.

action.roleActions: Watches the compass needle spin toward ancient ruins.

shots.description: The Treasure Seeker raises the Iron Key whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Discovers a keyhole hidden within carved stonework.
action.soundDesign: Wind through ruins and falling dust.

shots.description: The Treasure Seeker inserts the Iron Key whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Carefully turns the key inside the ancient mechanism.

shots.description: The Castaway examines the Temporal Compass whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Approaches a glowing artifact chamber.
action.dialogue: This is what brought me here.

shots.description: The Enforcer draws the Cutlass whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Blocks the chamber entrance and claims the treasure.

shots.description: The Pirate Captain levels the Captain's Flintlock whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Steps between allies and greed-driven mutineers.
action.soundDesign: Silence broken by distant stone creaks.

shots.description: The Trusted Deckhand swings the Cutlass whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Defends the crew and disarms attackers.

shots.description: The Castaway activates the Temporal Compass whilst standing inside the Ancient Spanish Ruins.

action.roleActions: Raises the compass toward the glowing artifact.
action.soundDesign: Rising temporal energy and harmonic resonance.

shots.description: The Castaway holds the Temporal Compass whilst standing on the Storm-Battered Reef.

action.roleActions: Emerges from the temporal storm and gazes toward a changed horizon.
action.soundDesign: Ocean ambience, fading temporal echoes, distant thunder.
